STOP: ordinary replay fails adopted reproduction gate
extended precision not wider than binary64
own process failure or actual OOM
classification: Report continuous metrics and qualified interpretations; do not select a causal winner from a single fitted phase.

method.claims: One saved initial state and two serialized circuits; no universal unitary equivalence or rigorous error certificate.
method.extended: Independent analytic small-gate kernels with NumPy longdouble/clongdouble; same gate order, qubit order, parameters and stored global phase; no transpile/decompose/synthesis.
method.gate_parameters: Preserve original serialized binary64 values exactly; do not reconstruct higher precision coefficients or replace angles.
method.global_phase: Apply each circuit stored global phase once. Fitted common phase is diagnostic only, never a corrected circuit or reference.
method.initial_state: Exactly saved low vector; no normalization or new probe state.
method.ordinary: Original simulator/global phase convention on each saved circuit, final measurement removed only.
method.unknown_gate: Fail closed rather than substitute Qiskit to_matrix in binary64.

parallel.admission: Fresh own affinity, idle CPU, RAM and disk; at most four workers because only four planned jobs exist. RSS proxies are workload estimates, never runtime caps.
parallel.inner_threads: Keep original ordinary replay environment; vectorize small-gate state updates. No full 8192x8192 circuit matrix.
parallel.reuse: Two saved QPY files and one low vector; exact-value gate/index caching when useful, no candidate/grid expansion.

runtime.policy: Reuse sealed recovery runtime; no shared package changes; additional longdouble precision must be checked before analysis.

technical_tolerances_PROPOSED_NOT_ADOPTE.extended_precision_requirement: actual mantissa bits strictly greater than binary64; otherwise STOP, no silent precision fallback
